import sys

def is_increasing(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    m = len(matrix[0])
    
    # Check rows
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1, m):
            if matrix[i][j] <= matrix[i][j - 1]:
                return False
    
    # Check columns
    for j in range(m):
        for i in range(1, n):
            if matrix[i][j] <= matrix[i - 1][j]:
                return False
    
    return True
